    Function reference

    FREM Model Management

    Primary functions for generating, updating and assembling FREM model files.

    createFREMmodel()
    Create a Complete FREM Model
    updateFREMmodel()
    Modify an exiting FREM model and data set

    FFEM Conversion

    Functions for transforming FREM models into FFEM.

    calcFFEM()
    Calculate the corresponding FFEM charactersitics from a FREM model-
    createFFEMdata()
    Create a new FFEM data set with the FREM covariat effect appended as columns
    createFFEMmodel()
    Create an FFEM version of a FREM model together with an appropriate data file.

    Data Assembly & Validation

    Utilities for data integrity, covariate binarization, and dataset setup.

    createFREMData()
    Create a FREM dataset from a standard NONMEM dataset.
    setupdfCovs()
    Create the input matrix for getExplainedVar

    Diagnostics & Plotting

    Functions for retrieving, summarizing, and visualizing model outputs.

    calcEtas()
    Calculate conditional ETAs (ETA prim)
    fremParameterTable()
    Generate the input to a parameter table for a FREM model
    getExplainedVar()
    Calculate the explained variability for covariates in a FREM model.
    getForestDFFREM()
    Compute statistics for a FREM model forest plot
    plotExplainedVar()
    Plot the explained variability of covariates in a FREM model
    traceplot()
    Create traceplots of OFV, thetas and omegas from a NONMEM run.

    NONMEM File Parsers

    Low-level utilities for parsing NONMEM output files and metadata.

    getCovNames()
    Get the covariate names from a FREM model file
    getExt()
    Read the information in a NONMEM ext file
    getFileNames()
    Collect filenames that are associated with a NONMEM run
    getPhi()
    Read the information in a NONMEM phi file
